title: Variance under coordinate monotonization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. The variance of the real-valued function obtained by monotonizing $f$ coordinate by coordinate equals the variance of $f$ viewed as a real-valued function.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
